title: Fireworks damage complaint before Police Commission
summary: Residents told the Police Commission a family's complaint about fireworks damage to their home has not been investigated after nine months, and the chair said the chosen investigator has not replied and the matter will be on the next agenda. A police official said he will review video and the department will open an administrative investigation if wrongdoing is found.
